verdict.rationale: Exa's docs include an API reference with request examples (a curl call against api.exa.ai/search), documented response schemas, downloadable OpenAPI specs, and a homepage 'API Playground', so the core of an explorable reference exists. However, the interactivity and in-page runnability of the reference are only implied by a bare 'API Playground' label rather than documented. missing for 10: documented in-reference 'try it' execution of examples, a description of what the API Playground does, and independent hands-on corroboration that the reference examples run as shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Download the OpenAPI specs for the Exa public API and Team Management API in YAML or JSON.
